title: CMHP – Pharmaceutical ERP System
oneLiner: A multi-company pharmaceutical ERP frontend supporting dual-entity production, digital batch manufacturing records (BMR), and automated inventory ledgers.
note: Built independently during internship at Vibe Tech Labs. Employer reference available.
description: Independently engineered the entire React frontend for an enterprise pharmaceutical ERP system supporting two manufacturing entities (CMHP Pharma and Tej Biocare) with a shared central raw material inventory.
Engineered comprehensive role-scoped workspaces covering HRMS, orders, stock ledgers, digital batch manufacturing records (BMR), quality assurance/control (QA/QC), and GST-compliant invoicing.
Focused on bulletproof client-side state reliability so factory operators can navigate multi-step manufacturing records without data loss on shop-floor tablets.

items: Company-isolated workspaces for CMHP Pharma and Tej Biocare with shared raw-material depot.
Real-time stock ledger calculation showing batch-wise balances, reorder thresholds, and expiration flags.
Role-based permission gating for plant supervisors, storekeepers, and procurement teams.
19-step digital Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) workflow replacing error-prone paper logs.
Quality control (QC) sampling checkpoints with pass/fail sign-offs and lab test documentation.
Automated GST sales/purchase invoice generation with line-item tax calculation.

challenges.title: Managing Complex Multi-Step Tablet BMR State
challenges.body: Floor operators fill out dense 19-stage manufacturing records on shop-floor tablets prone to network drops. Solved by implementing centralized serialized Redux state slices with auto-save checkpoints to guarantee zero record loss.

challenges.title: Dual-Entity Multi-Tenant Ledger Isolation
challenges.body: Preventing cross-company inventory leaks while sharing a physical depot required strict tenant scoping at the state and API interceptor layer.
